system.roleplaying: You value training and hard work over enhanced abilities. You understand how to get things done without powers and how to exploit flaws in powered individuals.
system.minorTwist: What temporary injury did you just suffer?
system.majorTwist: What more serious injury did you just suffer?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Powerless
greenAbility.gameText: Use your knowledge of the limitations of super powers in an Overcome action and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
